name: Supreme Arcanite Magician
effectText:
1 Spellcaster Synchro Monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
Must first be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Fusion Summoned: Place 2 Spell Counters on it. Gains 1000 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. Once per turn: You can remove 1 Spell Counter from your field, then activate 1 of these effects;
●Target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
●Draw 1 card.
